spans.text: Did... Did Kyouma-sensei really invent something so amazing?

units.displayText: Well done, Kyouma ~nya!

spans.text: Well done, Kyouma ~nya!

units.rawText: But of course! After all, I am the mad scientist, Hououin Kyouma!
units.displayText: But of course! After all, I am the mad scientist, Hououin Kyouma!

spans.text: But of course! After all, I am the mad scientist, Hououin Kyouma!

units.rawText: Creating something that can turn the world on its head is child's play for me! Muhahahaha!
units.displayText: Creating something that can turn the world on its head is child's play for me! Muhahahaha!

spans.text: Creating something that can turn the world on its head is child's play for me! Muhahahaha!

units.rawText: Alright then, please explain the principles to us, oh great and mighty mad scientist.
units.displayText: Alright then, please explain the principles to us, oh great and mighty mad scientist.

spans.text: Alright then, please explain the principles to us, oh great and mighty mad scientist.

units.rawText: Er...
units.displayText: Er...

spans.text: Er...

units.rawText: Ah... er... simply put, it uses Kerr black holes... And then, and then it...
units.displayText: Ah... er... simply put, it uses Kerr black holes... And then, and then it...

spans.text: Ah... er... simply put, it uses Kerr black holes... And then, and then it...

units.rawText: And then what?
units.displayText: And then what?

spans.text: And then what?

units.rawText: Damn you, Christina! As my Assistant, it's YOUR job to explain these operating principles to the other LabMems!
units.displayText: Damn you, Christina! As my Assistant, it's YOUR job to explain these operating principles to the other LabMems!

spans.text: Damn you, Christina! As my Assistant, it's YOUR job to explain these operating principles to the other LabMems!

units.rawText: Besides, right now D-Mails and how to send them are more important to the lab!
units.displayText: Besides, right now D-Mails and how to send them are more important to the lab!

spans.text: Besides, right now D-Mails and how to send them are more important to the lab!

units.rawText: Fine, fine, I just knew you couldn't hack it.
units.displayText: Fine, fine, I just knew you couldn't hack it.

spans.text: Fine, fine, I just knew you couldn't hack it.

units.rawText: Kurisu takes a deep breath, and then points to the modified microwave under the table.
units.displayText: Kurisu takes a deep breath, and then points to the modified microwave under the table.

spans.text: Kurisu takes a deep breath, and then points to the modified microwave under the table.

units.rawText: Simply put, D-Mails are a way of sending mails to the past via the PhoneWave.
units.displayText: Simply put, D-Mails are a way of sending mails to the past via the PhoneWave.

spans.text: Simply put, D-Mails are a way of sending mails to the past via the PhoneWave.

units.rawText: Use the full name! It's PhoneWave (name subject to change)!
units.displayText: Use the full name! It's PhoneWave (name subject to change)!

spans.text: Use the full name! It's PhoneWave (name subject to change)!

units.rawText: Yeah, whatever.
units.displayText: Yeah, whatever.

spans.text: Yeah, whatever.

units.rawText: When the PhoneWave runs backward, it begins to discharge electrical arcs. During this time, mails can be sent to the past.
units.displayText: When the PhoneWave runs backward, it begins to discharge electrical arcs. During this time, mails can be sent to the past.

spans.text: When the PhoneWave runs backward, it begins to discharge electrical arcs. During this time, mails can be sent to the past.

units.rawText: According to my calculations, 1 second on the microwave's timer corresponds to 1 hour in reality. In other words, if I wanted to send a D-Mail to Okabe from 5 days ago, I would have to have the microwave run in reverse for 120 seconds.
units.displayText: According to my calculations, 1 second on the microwave's timer corresponds to 1 hour in reality. In other words, if I wanted to send a D-Mail to Okabe from 5 days ago, I would have to have the microwave run in reverse for 120 seconds.

spans.text: According to my calculations, 1 second on the microwave's timer corresponds to 1 hour in reality. In other words, if I wanted to send a D-Mail to Okabe from 5 days ago, I would have to have the microwave run in reverse for 120 seconds.

units.rawText: After verifying the destination time and the contents of the mail you want to send,  you start up the microwave and wait for it to start producing arcs before pressing the Send button, which sends your email to the past.
units.displayText: After verifying the destination time and the contents of the mail you want to send,  you start up the microwave and wait for it to start producing arcs before pressing the Send button, which sends your email to the past.

spans.text: After verifying the destination time and the contents of the mail you want to send,  you start up the microwave and wait for it to start producing arcs before pressing the Send button, which sends your email to the past.

units.rawText: However, the length of these emails is limited to a maximum of 36 half-width characters or 18 full-width characters. All other data will be lost.
units.displayText: However, the length of these emails is limited to a maximum of 36 half-width characters or 18 full-width characters. All other data will be lost.

spans.text: However, the length of these emails is limited to a maximum of 36 half-width characters or 18 full-width characters. All other data will be lost.

units.rawText: So you can send mails to the past... Isn't that amazing?
units.displayText: So you can send mails to the past... Isn't that amazing?

spans.text: So you can send mails to the past... Isn't that amazing?

units.rawText: Hehehe, indeed! However, my mad scientist's ambition goes far beyond that!
units.displayText: Hehehe, indeed! However, my mad scientist's ambition goes far beyond that!

spans.text: Hehehe, indeed! However, my mad scientist's ambition goes far beyond that!

units.rawText: If we could go beyond sending emails to sending an entire person to another point in time—
units.displayText: If we could go beyond sending emails to sending an entire person to another point in time—

spans.text: If we could go beyond sending emails to sending an entire person to another point in time—

units.rawText: ...That's why you invented this miniature time machine, right?
units.displayText: ...That's why you invented this miniature time machine, right?

spans.text: ...That's why you invented this miniature time machine, right?

units.rawText: Why do you keep stealing my lines?!
units.displayText: Why do you keep stealing my lines?!

spans.text: Why do you keep stealing my lines?!

units.rawText: Ahem! Indeed! This is Future Gadget No. 099 Ver. 1.96, based on the D-Mail's principles!
units.displayText: Ahem! Indeed! This is Future Gadget No. 099 Ver. 1.96, based on the D-Mail's principles!

spans.text: Ahem! Indeed! This is Future Gadget No. 099 Ver. 1.96, based on the D-Mail's principles!

units.rawText: <size=40>Also known as—[FLAWLESS MONITOR]!</size>
units.displayText: Also known as—[FLAWLESS MONITOR]!

spans.text: Also known as—[FLAWLESS MONITOR]!

units.rawText: By the way, it's written as 完全無欠の監視者 in Japanese!
units.displayText: By the way, it's written as 完全無欠の監視者 in Japanese!

spans.text: By the way, it's written as 完全無欠の監視者 in Japanese!

units.rawText: ...What? Why did you all go quiet all of a sudden?
units.displayText: ...What? Why did you all go quiet all of a sudden?

spans.text: ...What? Why did you all go quiet all of a sudden?

units.rawText: I, I think that Perfect Observer or whatever is a great name!
units.displayText: I, I think that Perfect Observer or whatever is a great name!

spans.text: I, I think that Perfect Observer or whatever is a great name!

units.rawText: That's [Flawless Monitor], dammit!
units.displayText: That's [Flawless Monitor], dammit!

spans.text: That's [Flawless Monitor], dammit!

units.rawText: Ahem! In any case, this thing generates more fundamental particles than the PhoneWave (name subject to change).
units.displayText: Ahem! In any case, this thing generates more fundamental particles than the PhoneWave (name subject to change).

spans.text: Ahem! In any case, this thing generates more fundamental particles than the PhoneWave (name subject to change).

units.rawText: If my theory is right, it should be able to change the world!
units.displayText: If my theory is right, it should be able to change the world!

spans.text: If my theory is right, it should be able to change the world!

units.rawText: A very bold hypothesis. So, what were your experimental results?
units.displayText: A very bold hypothesis. So, what were your experimental results?

spans.text: A very bold hypothesis. So, what were your experimental results?

units.rawText: When will you learn that it is not the results that matter, but the process of obtaining them?
units.displayText: When will you learn that it is not the results that matter, but the process of obtaining them?

spans.text: When will you learn that it is not the results that matter, but the process of obtaining them?

units.rawText: ...In other words, all your prior experiments failed, right?
units.displayText: ...In other words, all your prior experiments failed, right?

spans.text: ...In other words, all your prior experiments failed, right?

units.rawText: Humph! So what if they did! Failure is the mother of success, after all!
units.displayText: Humph! So what if they did! Failure is the mother of success, after all!

spans.text: Humph! So what if they did! Failure is the mother of success, after all!

units.rawText: Also, my mad scientist's instincts are telling me that this activation is bound to succeed!
units.displayText: Also, my mad scientist's instincts are telling me that this activation is bound to succeed!

spans.text: Also, my mad scientist's instincts are telling me that this activation is bound to succeed!

units.rawText: Fine, fine. It's just as I thought. You'd be way smugger than this if you actually succeeded.
units.displayText: Fine, fine. It's just as I thought. You'd be way smugger than this if you actually succeeded.

spans.text: Fine, fine. It's just as I thought. You'd be way smugger than this if you actually succeeded.

units.rawText: I'll prove that my theory is correct right now!
units.displayText: I'll prove that my theory is correct right now!

spans.text: I'll prove that my theory is correct right now!

units.rawText: I point to Future Gadget No. 099 on the table.
units.displayText: I point to Future Gadget No. 099 on the table.

spans.text: I point to Future Gadget No. 099 on the table.

units.rawText: Future Gadget No. 099! No, I mean, "Flawless Monitor"!
units.displayText: Future Gadget No. 099! No, I mean, "Flawless Monitor"!

spans.text: Future Gadget No. 099! No, I mean, "Flawless Monitor"!

units.rawText: Show your true hidden might to me, the mad scientist!
units.displayText: Show your true hidden might to me, the mad scientist!

spans.text: Show your true hidden might to me, the mad scientist!

units.rawText: Click—
units.displayText: Click—

spans.text: Click—

units.rawText: As expected, nothing happens after I push the switch.
units.displayText: As expected, nothing happens after I push the switch.

spans.text: As expected, nothing happens after I push the switch.

units.rawText: Er... This, this is...
units.displayText: Er... This, this is...

spans.text: Er... This, this is...

units.rawText: Just as I'm thinking about how to blame everything on the Organization and wrap things up, the Future Gadget No. 099 in my hands seems to understand what I'm saying and turns on.
units.displayText: Just as I'm thinking about how to blame everything on the Organization and wrap things up, the Future Gadget No. 099 in my hands seems to understand what I'm saying and turns on.

spans.text: Just as I'm thinking about how to blame everything on the Organization and wrap things up, the Future Gadget No. 099 in my hands seems to understand what I'm saying and turns on.

units.rawText: (Crackle) (Crackle)
units.displayText: (Crackle) (Crackle)

spans.text: (Crackle) (Crackle)

units.rawText: Dangerous electrical arcs begin spewing from Future Gadget No. 099.
units.displayText: Dangerous electrical arcs begin spewing from Future Gadget No. 099.

spans.text: Dangerous electrical arcs begin spewing from Future Gadget No. 099.

units.rawText: Nya?! Is, is that lightning?
units.displayText: Nya?! Is, is that lightning?

spans.text: Nya?! Is, is that lightning?

units.rawText: Aiiiiieeeeee! What, what's happening?!
units.displayText: Aiiiiieeeeee! What, what's happening?!

spans.text: Aiiiiieeeeee! What, what's happening?!

units.rawText: Okabe! What did you just do?!
units.displayText: Okabe! What did you just do?!

spans.text: Okabe! What did you just do?!

units.rawText: I didn't do anything! Daru, did you install a voice-activated controller into it?
units.displayText: I didn't do anything! Daru, did you install a voice-activated controller into it?

spans.text: I didn't do anything! Daru, did you install a voice-activated controller into it?

units.rawText: Of course... not! You think we're rich enough for that?
units.displayText: Of course... not! You think we're rich enough for that?

spans.text: Of course... not! You think we're rich enough for that?

units.rawText: I'm pretty sure I didn't do anything else to it, but why did the hitherto quiescent Future Gadget No. 099 suddenly react so strongly?
units.displayText: I'm pretty sure I didn't do anything else to it, but why did the hitherto quiescent Future Gadget No. 099 suddenly react so strongly?

spans.text: I'm pretty sure I didn't do anything else to it, but why did the hitherto quiescent Future Gadget No. 099 suddenly react so strongly?

units.rawText: The ground beneath my feet suddenly starts shaking.
units.displayText: The ground beneath my feet suddenly starts shaking.

spans.text: The ground beneath my feet suddenly starts shaking.

units.rawText: The lab is... Is, is that an earthquake? Oh no, my waifus!
units.displayText: The lab is... Is, is that an earthquake? Oh no, my waifus!

spans.text: The lab is... Is, is that an earthquake? Oh no, my waifus!

units.rawText: Everybody, run! I'll cut the power!
units.displayText: Everybody, run! I'll cut the power!

spans.text: Everybody, run! I'll cut the power!

units.rawText: Just as I'm about to move, an intense electrical arc suddenly discharges in Mayuri and Kurisu's direction.
units.displayText: Just as I'm about to move, an intense electrical arc suddenly discharges in Mayuri and Kurisu's direction.

spans.text: Just as I'm about to move, an intense electrical arc suddenly discharges in Mayuri and Kurisu's direction.

units.rawText: Ahhhhhhhhh!
units.displayText: Ahhhhhhhhh!

spans.text: Ahhhhhhhhh!

units.rawText: Mayuri! Look out!
units.displayText: Mayuri! Look out!

spans.text: Mayuri! Look out!

units.rawText: <size=60>MAYURI!</size>
units.displayText: MAYURI!

spans.text: MAYURI!

units.rawText: Kurisu tries to grab Mayuri, but she is pinned down by the electrical current. I frantically run toward them, but I end up stepping on something and my foot slips—
units.displayText: Kurisu tries to grab Mayuri, but she is pinned down by the electrical current. I frantically run toward them, but I end up stepping on something and my foot slips—

spans.text: Kurisu tries to grab Mayuri, but she is pinned down by the electrical current. I frantically run toward them, but I end up stepping on something and my foot slips—

units.rawText: <size=40>Boom!!</size>
units.displayText: Boom!!

spans.text: Boom!!

units.rawText: There is a mighty impact. Blinding white light fills my vision, and that is where my memories stop.
units.displayText: There is a mighty impact. Blinding white light fills my vision, and that is where my memories stop.
